notes.title: Happy New Years
notes.notes:
🌟 Happy New Year, Spider Warriors! 🌟

As we swing into a brand-new year, the Spider Wars team wishes you all a fantastic 2025 filled with exciting new adventures! 🎉🕷️

Thank you for being a part of the Spider Wars community. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in shaping the game, and we can't wait to see where this year takes us all.

Gear up, and let's make 2025 the most legendary year in Spider Wars history!

🕷️ See you on the battlefield, warriors!

notes.title: Transition to 1.0
notes.notes:
🕷️ Spider Wars, the epic arachnid adventure that once spun its web across screens, is now taking its final bow. As we step out of the early access cocoon, we want to share our heartfelt gratitude with our loyal web-slingers and eight-legged explorers.

The Journey So Far
From the very beginning, Spider Wars crawled into your hearts. We embarked on this journey together, weaving intricate narratives, battling venomous foes, and exploring the tangled threads of our imagination. You, our players, were the architects of this digital silk—a community that swung through every update, every bug fix, and every daring leap from skyscraper to skyscraper.

A Web of Challenges
But alas, even the most resilient spiders face challenges. Sales didn’t weave the golden silk we hoped for. The marketplace was a labyrinth, and our little arachnids struggled to find their place. We spun intricate mechanics, crafted captivating lore, and designed colossal webs, yet the winds of fate blew us in unexpected directions.

The Final Thread
With heavy hearts, we’ve decided to let Spider Wars rest. There won’t be any more updates, no new threads to spin. Our team of passionate devs will move on to new adventures, perhaps even donning the exoskeletons of mechs or exploring uncharted galaxies. But Spider Wars will forever remain etched in our memories—a dew-kissed web shimmering in the morning sun.

Thank You, Web Warriors
To our players, our testers, and our fellow dreamweavers, thank you. Your feedback, bug reports, and enthusiasm fueled our creativity. You swung alongside us, and for that, we’re grateful. 🕸️

What’s Next?
As the sun sets on Spider Wars, we invite you to explore other dimensions, chase new quests, and discover untold stories. Perhaps our paths will cross again, in a different corner of the digital multiverse.

Until then, remember: Every web has its final strand.
There will be a new project on the horizon. 

Thank you to every one of you!

notes.title: Update Delays
notes.notes:
Hi all 
We hope you are well and safe during these tough times. We are still working to try finish the migration to steam networking. This is a huge task and is taking more time than we had anticipated. Our programming team is hard at work trying to get this done. As Spider Wars is coming to an end we have started work on a much smaller Game with the Art team in order to try get some more funding for the studio.  

Things are tough for everyone at the moment and we wish you all the best of luck.

Should you be in a position to help check out our Patreon page at [url=https://www.patreon.com/SpiderWars]https://www.patreon.com/SpiderWars[/url]

notes.title: New feature in survival
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/7fb94d7e081aaf4b431748730711038f8b9e5bf7.png[/img]
The survival based map and mode will come with it's own unique features. One such feature will involve resource extractions from fallen crystals. 

These extractions will occur when the player interacts with a rare crystal that will fall down from the sky. There will then be a refinery unit that is dropped from space. The refinery unit will harvest the designated crystal over a period of time in which the player will have to defend the refinery unit from other players. There will be a shield split evenly among the player, their friends and the refinery unit up to a limited range. This shield will serve the purpose of helping the player defend the refinery units until departure.

Players attacking the refinery unit and its' defenders will have to capture possession of it before the unit leaves after a set time.

We hope you have a great weekend,
- CarVin Team

notes.title: Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
Greetings, 

I am a new addition to the CarVin Team and I am hoping to bring in some fresh views, abilities and development done to the Spider Wars Universe!

We also have some updates coming to Spider Wars soon.

These changes involve:
- Menu UI has been reworked to keep the style and theme coherent.
- Chameleon Neutral Enemy added (Will Target AI bugs).
- Crab Hostile Enemy added to patrol the coastal line (Will Target players).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/caa395b5a4b9989e19cb2da8c60f83ed7fe944de.png[/img]

These changes may be small and mainly affect, but they should appear more often and hopefully get bigger and better as time goes on.

Feel free to post any suggestions or  leave feedback, I am here and i am amped!

Happy Lunar New Years!
CarVin Team

notes.title: Something new...
notes.notes:
We are currently working on two big updates. 
 
1) Bots for Multiplayer 
This is a massive task for our small Company, so we have our programming department on it full time.  
 
2) Solo/Co-op/Pvp Survival mode 
So far we are testing a 5km square map. It will be the largest map in Spider Wars. The players will set out ,without there implants as regular spiders. 
Spiders can acquire an Armour set by going to the middle of the map and crafting a set at the ruins. (no fire zone) 
 
Each class in the game will be craftable. 
 
We will include setting for Solo Pvp and Pve. 
 
As always thank you to everyone for your support it means the world to us. 
 
Keep well  
-Carvin Team

notes.title: Update is finally here!
notes.notes:
Alpha 0.3 :

Added 2 new single player levels : Lost Temple and Tunnel, which include :
*New enemies
*Mini boss 
*New food type 

Note there is no save/load feature yet but we are working on one. To get trough the levels, you will need to start at Dead Trees (level 1)

Dead Tree's (single player) has been updated.
*Added Giant Worm.
*Added Hornet enemies. 
*Added Vortex. 
*Added a few more rocks to the terrain

General Changes 
*Mist has been reduced so that you can see further.
*All spiders lights (L key) have had a range and radius increase.
*Added missing sounds
*Fixed  Bots not spawning in tower 
*Fixed Strange lighting on spiders.

notes.title: Single player update #2
notes.notes:
Change log 0.2

The Single player update is here.
We added the first part of the single player story. 
So build those webs up and there may be a surprise for you all.

Single player levels: 
Crystalis. 
Tower.

Weather system implemented. Phase 1.

All Spiders now start with 50% web.
Re-skin for all spiders (scout ,medic, artillery and Assault)
Complete  water rework.
Updated Camera Effects.

Added render distance slider to settings.
Added reflection Probes to multiplayer levels. 
Added new abilities trans-locator to Artillery. 
Added Ai.
Added Nav Mesh.
Added Ai Phase 1 (single player only)

Fixed bug spawns. 
Fixed Water Refection.
Fixed Audio volume issue.
Fixed Lighting.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/4076e0eb3755867dee11e11bf55bdf87acc07734.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Single Player update #2 info
notes.notes:
The second single player update will be done within the next month.
We are working hard to bring you more than just build a web mode.
There is a story in the works and this is just the first chapter in many more to come. For the time being we are not going to be focusing on multiplayer at all and devote all our funding and attention towards a single player story. We are also making sure not to miss out the importance of co-op, which will be our second priority. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/2e313596628481bea9a34b71d0b08bde264cd859.jpg[/img]

Here are two images as a sneak peak of a new level to be included in the next update. We really appreciate the feedback from you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26901344/4076e0eb3755867dee11e11bf55bdf87acc07734.jpg[/img]


Thank you to everyone so far for all your support!

notes.title: The single player "Build a Web" mode is now live!
notes.notes:
This is the first of the single player/co-op modes coming to Spiders Wars.
Build a web to catch and eat bugs. The more you eat, the bigger your web can get.The co-op version is coming soon.

notes.title: Single Player / Co-op on its way.
notes.notes:
We are glad to inform you all about our new single player and co-op modes starting with the first mode "Build a web" 

The update will be ready to play on Wednesday 30th November.

This mode is a more relaxing mode where you can build the web of your dreams alone or with a friend.

You will also be able to build alot more web than previously within this mode. 

Spiders will be able to eat bugs to make more web.

More updates for Co-op / Single player coming weekly.

Looking forward  to seeing you all in-game 
Have a great day.

The CarVin Team
